leadText:
Kinnow Island (Japanese: ハッサク島 Hassaku Island) is an island in the eastern region of the Orange Islands.

 and arrived at Kinnow Island's port at the end of Stage Fight!.

In Bye Bye Psyduck, met fellow enthusiast , who rescued Misty's Psyduck after he wandered off. The two decided to have a three-on-three , during which Misty encountered a , initially believing her Psyduck had evolved. While the Golduck followed Misty's commands, it later left her side to show off for another group of girls while Misty's Psyduck returned.

The island has a large city and a big beach. A deserted island nearby is also considered to be a part of Kinnow Island.
